Kress Takes Point on Nvidia Results as Chip Maker Beats Expectations

Plus, Anthropic plans to raise IPO price

By

Nvidia ’s interim CEO Colette Kress took point on her first earnings call yesterday since the ouster of star founder and leader Jensen Huang last week. She did take some steps to allay concerns.

“Our momentum is real,” Kress said, in a slow, steady, almost monotone delivery throughout her presentation. “Our ambitions will not change.”
